pages.title: Watching Mobs
pages.text: By looking at a mob through a Spyglass, some information will be provided onscreen, including the name of the mob, a rough estimation of its health, and a rough warning about their Threat Level, relative to yours.$(br2)Thus, the Spyglass is a way for players to gauge the danger a mob can pose before approaching them.

pages.title: Spyglass
pages.text: Use JEI to find the current Spyglass recipe and its required materials. Once you have one, look through it at wildlife to learn about the creature before approaching.
